title: Performance sprint journal — Priya Nair
content:
Purpose and use
- Quick-running personal sprint journal for end-of-quarter prep and 1:1 manager syncs. Not polished — rolling notes, snippets I want to surface to my manager or HR partners.

Topline objective (Q4 stretch): Improve onboarding->time-to-signal for new hires from 8 weeks to 5 weeks for core ICs (engineering & product), measured by first shipped PR and first measurable user-facing metric.

Signals of progress (metrics I track)
- New-hire ramp: median time-to-first-PR (target 3w, current 5.5w) — last cohort median 4.9w (improved vs baseline 6.2w).
- Onboarding NPS: piloted quick NPS pulse — 62 (n=18). Goal 70+.
- Documentation coverage: checklist completion rate in onboarding playbook flows — 78% complete across 3 teams. Want +12 pts.

Recent wins to call out in sync
- Ran a 2-week onboarding blitz with EngInfra + DX: consolidated 14 duplicate pages into a single canonical flow; removed 6 out-of-date steps. Result: new-hire blockers reported during week 1 dropped 40% in pilot.
- Negotiated small headcount shift to temp contractor for docs migration; freed up 0.2 FTE for program management.
- Built a simple 'first-week checklist' template that team leads adopted for recent hires (Linked: CONFLUENCE-people-ops-onboarding-checklist).

Examples/anecdotes to humanize the numbers
- Maya (SWE-2) joined 2025-12-03, shipped first small bugfix in week 2 after paired setup session with mentor — she explicitly called out the checklist in her feedback. Quote: "setup felt much less scary — mentor session + checklist = clear path."
- Negative anecdote: One manager didn't schedule mentor time and ramp slowed — useful for coaching point: onboarding is manager+org responsibility, not just ops.

Areas to highlight as risks / blockers
- Docs cleanup is still manual in places — lack of ownership for the library will cause regressions unless we assign content owners.
- Cross-team alignment: Platform team wants different CLA flow; conflict with centralized template. Need arbitration.
- Automated seat provisioning delays persist (median ticket turnaround 3.4 days). Infra SRE bandwidth is limited.

Concrete asks for manager (prep bullets)
- Ask for prioritized headcount reprioritization: request 0.25 FTE through Q2 for documentation ownership or contractor budget for 6 months.
- Ask for exec leverage to lock down CLA flow decision (point person: Matt P.).
- Ask for support to include onboarding metrics in Eng leadership weekly dashboard (1 metric slot).

Career / performance narrative snippets (short, direct)
- Impact: "Led cross-functional onboarding blitz that reduced week-1 blockers by ~40% in pilot, increasing new-hire activation speed and lowering mentor friction."
- Leadership: "Owned alignment across EngInfra, DX and Eng managers to consolidate knowledge artifacts and introduce a repeatable onboarding checklist."
- Crafting my ask: "I am seeking recognition for expanded scope (onboarding program + operational tooling) and a small budget/headcount to make improvements sustainable."

Evidence bank (what I can drop into PR/promo packet)
- Before/after metrics (time-to-first-PR, blocker reports) — export CSV from JIRA onboarding tickets, pulse survey results.
- Stakeholder emails endorsing the approach: (Liam O'Connor, eng manager) and (Amelia Chen, DX lead).
- Link to the playbook and checklist (CONFLUENCE-people-ops-onboarding-checklist) and the migration notes doc.

One-on-one conversation starters
- "Quick update: pilot reduced week-1 blockers by ~40% — I recommend funding a stable owner to avoid rollback. Thoughts on budget prioritization?"
- "Given the CLA flow conflict, can you help escalate to Matt to get a final decision by end of next sprint?"
- "Calibration: I feel like scope of my role has expanded into a small program management domain — I want to discuss expectations and potential recognition pathways."

Draft talking points for manager meeting (2–3 minutes each)
- 60s: Problem framing (onboarding variance causes lost productivity) + 30s: pilot result snapshot + 30s: ask (budget/headcount) + 30s: next steps (owner + timeline).

Short-term to-dos (next 2 weeks)
- Finalize owners list for each doc page (owner assignments + due dates).
- Pull last 6 onboarding JIRA tickets, create a short CSV export for time-to-first-PR analysis.
- Draft 1-paragraph funding pitch for contractors; share with manager before Wed 2026-02-24.

Longer-term experiments I want to try
- Mentor pairing rubric experiment: structured 2-hour mentor onboarding session in week 1 vs ad-hoc pairing — measure time-to-first-PR and happiness.
- Auto-provisioning pilot with templated infra tickets that reduce manual steps (partner: eng-sre).
- Lightweight 'pre-boarding' checklist sent 7 days before start to cut first-week friction.

Personal reflection / development notes
- Strengths to lean into: cross-functional facilitation, concise playbook building, pilot execution.
- Development areas: stronger data chops (SQL / small analytics) to own metric exports; negotiation with senior engineering leaders — want to be more direct and succinct.
- Micro-goal: complete internal analytics course + build a reproducible onboarding metrics dashboard by end of Q2.

Loose thoughts / friction items I want to capture (brain dump)
- Might be worth a quarterly "docs health" rotation where teams claim canonical pages. Could be on rotation.
- Wonder if we should formalize a manager checklist that is mandatory at offer-accept stage — legal + people-ops + eng managers signoff.
- Would love a small data automation grant to build the dashboard — make a tight ask (cost + 3-month timeline).

Notes for follow-up items (owners)
- Assign content owners: Liam -> infra pages, Amelia -> DX onboarding flow, Priya -> central checklist (me).
- Infra ticket: SRE to estimate auto-provisioning work -> JIRA-OPS-721 (assigned to SRE lead).
- Budget pitch: draft and circulate by 2026-02-21.

Last quick checklist before manager 1:1
- [ ] Export metrics and attach CSV
- [ ] Draft 1-paragraph ask for budget (contractor)
- [ ] Add two short quotes from stakeholders to evidence bank
- [ ] Finalize clear 30s ask and 30s follow-up plan

End of page — will iterate as I prep slides or a one-pager.

---
Revision history (notes)
- 2025-11-02: created initial template and baseline metrics.
- 2025-12-18: added pilot results and anecdote from Maya.
- 2026-01-20: noted new infra ticket JIRA-OPS-721 and started stakeholder outreach.
- 2026-02-18: tightened asks and set timeline for budget pitch.
